methodology.driver_gate: Phenomena require three incoming drivers, operational indicators require one, and responses plus explicitly authored root drivers are exempt.
methodology.important_boundary: The driver gate is a coverage test, not permission to create unsupported edges. Each candidate relationship still needs relationship-specific evidence and bounded causal wording.
methodology.graph_source: src/data.js live NODES and EDGES export

findings.evidence: 366 of 531 non-response nodes fail their semantic driver gate; 403 remain below three incoming drivers in the raw topology.
findings.risk: The graph presents many phenomena as single-cause spokes and cannot yet express realistic multi-driver pathways.
findings.remediation: Research and promote relationship-specific drivers in evidence batches, prioritizing anchors and high-impact generated nodes.

findings.evidence: 276 of 378 generated phenomena have exactly one incoming driver; 328 have no outgoing effects.
findings.risk: Generated nodes inherit a label and evidence family without becoming meaningful causal participants in the graph.
findings.remediation: Replace one-anchor generation with a research queue requiring multiple independent mechanisms and at least one downstream effect where defensible.

findings.evidence: 558 of 577 nodes have neither a calibration metric nor a defined metric contract; 14 now have explicit API-ready contracts.
findings.risk: Most scores cannot be refreshed from an observed quantity, so API ingestion cannot reliably update the graph.
findings.remediation: Introduce metric contracts per anchor: metric, unit, geography, cadence, source, observation time, transformation, uncertainty, and threshold provenance.

findings.evidence: 274 of 1054 edges lack relationship-specific source URLs.
findings.risk: Node-level sources may be incorrectly read as supporting the direction or mechanism of an edge.
findings.remediation: Require relationship_source_urls and a bounded mechanism before promoting inferred or family-level edges.

findings.evidence: 53 nodes lack human-impact context, 132 lack planetary context, and 35 use generic economic fallback text.
findings.risk: The same topology reads as universal even when pathways vary by geography, population, timescale, and system vulnerability.
findings.remediation: Add structured spatial scope, temporal horizon, exposed systems/populations, moderators, countervailing factors, and uncertainty.

findings.evidence: 225 of 577 graph nodes are covered by a source-attachment rule.
findings.risk: Many sources exist in the registry but are not connected to refreshable node or relationship contracts.
findings.remediation: Map source bundles to node metrics and edge evidence, then test coverage and freshness in CI.
